subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): identify each instance with service.instance.id

question: Should diagnostics-otel introduce `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` with a hostname fallback, or should instance identity be implemented only through the standard OTel resource path plus an OpenClaw-approved stable identity source?
rationale: The code change is small, but choosing a collector-visible stable instance identity affects operator configuration, privacy expectations, docs, and the canonical resource-identity issue.

options.title: Use Standard OTel Identity
options.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` or the maintainer-approved OpenClaw identity seam.

options.title: Adopt The New Env Contract
options.body: Accept `OTEL_SERVICE_INSTANCE_ID` as a new OpenClaw-supported env surface, but document precedence, privacy, and upgrade behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause For Identity Design
options.body: Keep this PR paused while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93071 settles the stable identity source and exported-resource proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Use Standard OTel Identity
recommendation.body: Remove the custom env variable and hostname fallback, then implement instance identity through `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` or the maintainer-approved OpenClaw identity seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about diagnostics-otel's product/API contract, and steipete introduced the exporter and adjacent OTel log behavior.
